title: Squash to Pickleball (Michelle Grogan)
style: funk-rnb-reggaeton-cumbia-dnb fusion 132bpm slap bass Rhodes sax horns dembow marimba guiro congas dnb chorus beatbox claps English Spanish coach calls
lyrics:
[Intro]
Squash to pickleball welcome to the court
Different walls different sport
Squash to pickleball outdoor day
No back wall comes into play

[Verse 1]
Squash is wrist snap quick and tight
Pickleball asks for paddle straight and light
Squash you swing and the ball comes back
Pickleball net stops the attack track
Uno dos tres make it short
No wall behind you on the court
Squash is fast at the front wall low
Pickleball drop is the soft way to go

[Pre-Chorus]
No wall no wall no wall back
No wall stops the ball off track
No wall no wall no wall back
Learn the open court tact

[Chorus]
Squash to pickleball drop the wrist flick
Long stroke with the paddle do the trick
Squash to pickleball read the kitchen line
Seven feet of no volley time
Vamos vamos pa lante
Open court game
Vamos vamos pa lante
Different name same flame

[Verse 2]
Squash is wrist quick and ready
Pickleball wants the swing more steady
Squash boast and drop are quick reads
Pickleball drop has different needs
Third shot drop arc up and over
Land it in the kitchen four leaf clover
Low center of mass split step low
Ready ready the paddle ready to go

[Bridge]
No back wall to bail you out
Footwork forward not in doubt
Two bounce rule serve and return
Let it bounce twice before you turn

[Chorus]
Squash to pickleball drop the wrist flick
Long stroke with the paddle do the trick
Squash to pickleball read the kitchen line
Seven feet of no volley time

[Outro]
Squash to pickleball welcome to the court
Different walls different sport
Squash to pickleball outdoor day
No back wall comes into play
